messages:
maria.k: Quick sync on AWS KMS for Redwood Private (VPC): need RBAC split, audit fields, safe rewrap + incident playbook. Short answers please.

samir.s: RBAC: two roles. controlplane-admin (create/describe/disable/tag), dataplane-runtime (GenerateDataKey, Decrypt, DescribeKey only). No CreateKey on runtime.

alex_dev: Envelope rules: controlplane stores KEK references only. Dataplane gets DEK plaintext in memory, never persisted. Implement in-memory cache with TTL and zeroing.

jen_ops: Rewrap outline: 1) provision new KEK alias 2) dry-run re-encrypt to staging 3) 5% canary traffic 4) batch rewrap with exponential backoff for KMS throttling 5) validate -> disable old KEK -> schedule deletion.

samir.s: Audit fields to ingest: eventTime, eventName, userIdentity, requestParameters.keyId, requestParameters.encryptionContext, responseElements.ciphertextBlob, redwoodRequestId, redwoodRoute, kms:grantId. Use compact JSON in encryptionContext for queries.

devsec-bot: [best-practice] Prefer CreateGrant for short-lived pod access. Use constraints (encryptionContextEquals) and retire grants on termination.

alex_dev: Grant flow: pod requests grant token from controlplane -> controlplane CreateGrant with constraints -> returns grantToken -> pod uses grantToken to call KMS. Controlplane logs grantToken mapping for audit.

jen_ops: Incident fast path (KEK compromise): 1) create new KEK 2) retire grants + revoke tokens 3) prioritize rewrap for sensitive namespaces 4) run CloudTrail query for old KEK use 5) notify legal/customer if needed.

maria.k: Action owners: alex -> controlplane policies & grant API PR. jen -> rewrap automation + canary playbook. samir -> CloudTrail/Athena queries and dashboards. I'll prepare incident templates. PRs by next Wed.

samir.s: Small test: add CI integration using sandbox KMS to run a mini rewrap cycle. Catches regressions.

jen_ops: Also document cross-region read-only fallback: secondary KEK for emergency decrypt only, with strict monitoring and rotation sync.

maria.k: Thanks. I'll provision a 7-day staging key if needed. Closing thread and creating backlog tasks.
